invalidation_condition: If PPI MoM actual < 0.0%, downside pressure replaces upside. If immediate risk-off (equities gap down >1%), safe-haven JPY strength overrides USD inflation signal.
stage_reason: PPI MoM +0.3% surprise (vs prior -0.1%) and Core PPI MoM +0.2% consensus directly signal producer inflation reacceleration. Attention rank 1 (PPI MoM, conf 0.9) and rank 2 (Core PPI MoM, conf 0.85) primary drivers. USD/JPY has strong 24h uptrend (+43.5%), providing momentum support. DXY down marginally (-0.085%) pre-release, leaving room for USD strength repricing. Initial market reaction: long USD/JPY on inflation surprise, hawkish read on Fed rate path. Real yields (US 2Y at 4.85, inverted curve -37bp) may initially steepen on inflation surprise.

invalidation_condition: If US 2Y yields spike +8bp or more on hawkish hold repricing (triggering profit-taking in USD longs). If S&P 500 futures signal equity weakness post-PPI (risk-off), JPY safe-haven bid emerges.
stage_reason: Inflation narrative consolidates: secondary drivers (Core PPI YoY 2.4%, rank 5 conf 0.75; PPI YoY 2.2%, rank 4 conf 0.75) reinforce reacceleration. Market reprices Fed rate-hold odds higher; real rates adjust upward (2Y yield may edge +2–4bp). USD strength persists as capital rotates into higher-for-longer rates. Context-only data (PPI ex-food/energy flat MoM, stable YoY) shows producer inflation not driven by supply shocks—persistent demand/pricing power. JPY weakness extends as USD carry attractiveness increases vs BOJ on-hold stance. 24h momentum still supportive (156.417 up from 155.739). Reversal risks begin building: (1) Treasury market pricing enters feedback loop—yields may overshoot; (2) positioning: long USD/JPY crowding; (3) BOJ verbal intervention possibility.

invalidation_condition: Reversal fails if Fed communications (post-cutoff but anticipated) signal hawkish surprise. If DXY rallies to 106+, USD strength overwhelms mean-reversion timing.
stage_reason: Reversal onset. By 30min, market has digested headline inflation surprise. Attention shifts to marginal dovish signal: PPI ex-food/energy MoM flat (rank 9, context-only) and YoY stable suggest underlying pricing pressures remain controlled outside energy volatility. Fed interpretation: no imminent hawkish repricing beyond current levels. Treasury curve flattens as long-end sellers emerge (real yields look expensive post-spike). Real 2Y-10Y remain inverted; recession/slowdown risks resurface. USD/JPY momentum exhaustion: 24h gains (+43.5%) suggest mean-reversion setup. Short-term profit-taking in longs. JPY begins recovery on both (a) stabilized real rates ruling out further Fed tightening, and (b) potential equity consolidation (VIX implied volatility may rise as market absorbs data). Initial 5–15min gain of ~15–20 pips reverses partially.

invalidation_condition: Sustained downtrend invalidates if Fed unannounced hawkish signal (post-cutoff) emerges, or if equity rally post-PPI sustains risk-on (contradicting reversal thesis). Upside reinvigoration if DXY breaks above 106.5.
stage_reason: Full reversal window established. By 60min, narrative stabilizes: inflation surprise (PPI MoM +0.3%) is data-dependent, not macro-regime shift. Core inflation YoY (2.4%) and ex-food/energy trends (stable) indicate base effects and timing factors, not persistent spiral. Market reprices: Fed likely remains on hold; no imminent rate hikes on this print. Real yields stabilize at post-PPI levels (~50–100bp higher in real 2Y). Treasury 2Y-10Y inversion persists, reinforcing recession narrative. USD/JPY reverses meaningfully as (1) initial inflation-driven USD strength unwinds, (2) carry-trade unwind accelerates (BOJ remain accommodative, widening policy divergence but shrinking rate premium), and (3) risk-on sentiment may stabilize (post-data volatility subsides, equities stabilize). 24h momentum fades; 1h realized vol (4.854e-05) remains low—no sudden dislocation. Best estimate: price retraces ~60–70% of initial 5–15min rally by 60min, settling near 156.0–156.2 range.
